blobstores.list.title: Blob Stores
blobstores.list.description: Configure local and cloud blob storage
blobstores.list.name: Name
blobstores.create.title: Create Blob Store
blobstores.create.description: Set up where repositories keep their data
blobstores.form.name: Name
blobstores.form.nameHint: A unique identifier. Use letters, digits, underscores and hyphens (for example maven-releases)
blobstores.form.readOnly: You can read these settings but not change them.
blobstores.form.errors.namePattern: Use letters, digits, '-', '_' and '.'; the name cannot start with '_' or '.'
blobstores.form.errors.bucketRequired: Enter the name of the bucket
blobstores.form.errors.bucketPattern: Use 3 to 63 lower-case letters, digits, '.' and '-', starting and ending with a letter or digit
blobstores.form.errors.expiration: Enter a whole number of days, or -1
blobstores.form.errors.keyIdRequired: Enter the access key ID that goes with the secret
blobstores.form.errors.endpoint: Enter an http:// or https:// address with a host
blobstores.form.errors.urlRequired: Enter the address of the agent
blobstores.form.errors.tokenRequired: Enter the token of the agent
blobstores.form.errors.certificate: Paste one or more PEM certificates
blobstores.file.pathHint: An absolute path, or a path relative to <data-directory>/blobs
blobstores.s3.bucketText: The bucket and the place in it where the blobs are kept. They cannot change once the store holds blobs.
blobstores.s3.bucketHint: Created when it does not exist yet.
blobstores.s3.regionHint: For example eu-central-1; DEFAULT takes the region from the environment.
blobstores.s3.prefixHint: A folder in the bucket for this store; empty uses the whole bucket.
blobstores.s3.expirationHint: -1 keeps deleted blobs; kept for a lifecycle rule of the bucket.
blobstores.s3.credentialsText: Leave them empty to use the credentials the server finds in its environment, profile or instance role.
blobstores.s3.roleHint: The ARN of an IAM role the server assumes with these credentials.
blobstores.s3.sessionTokenHint: Only for temporary credentials. Left empty, a stored token is kept while the access key ID stays the same.
blobstores.s3.kmsKeyHint: Empty uses the key AWS manages for S3.
blobstores.s3.endpointHint: For a service compatible with S3, such as MinIO; empty uses AWS.
blobstores.s3.pathStyleHint: The bucket goes into the path instead of the host name; most services compatible with S3 need it.
blobstores.remote.sectionText: The blob agent on the server whose disk keeps the blobs.
blobstores.remote.urlHint: For example https://storage1.internal:8090. An internal address has to be allowed in the SSRF protection first.
blobstores.remote.credentialsText: The token the agent was started with, and the certificate to trust when the agent has one of its own.
blobstores.remote.tokenHint: At least 32 characters. Left empty, the stored token is kept while the address stays the same.
blobstores.remote.certificateHint: The PEM certificate of the agent or of its CA; empty trusts the usual public authorities.
blobstores.group.text: Reads look in every member; new blobs go to a member chosen by the fill policy.
blobstores.group.membersHint: A member that holds blobs cannot be removed.
blobstores.group.fillPolicyHint: Which member receives a new blob.
blobstores.group.writeToFirst: The first member that can take it
blobstores.group.mostFreeSpace: The member with the most free space
blobstores.quota.title: Soft Quota
blobstores.quota.text: Warn when the store passes the limit
blobstores.quota.usedHint: Warn when the store holds more than this.
blobstores.quota.remainingHint: Warn when less than this is free.
blobstores.edit.memberOf: It is a member of the group {groups}.
blobstores.edit.cannotDelete: It cannot be deleted while it is in use.
blobstores.edit.unavailable: The server cannot reach this blob store. Check its settings and the storage behind it.
blobstores.edit.unsupported: This type of blob store is not supported
blobstores.edit.unsupportedText: The server keeps blobs in file, S3, remote and group stores; {type} stores cannot be managed here.
blobstores.edit.notFound: There is no blob store named {name} of this type.
blobstores.delete.title: Delete the blob store {name}?
blobstores.delete.text: Its configuration is removed. A file store's folder is removed when it is empty; an S3 bucket is left as it is. This cannot be undone.
blobstores.convert.title: Convert {name} to a group?
blobstores.convert.text: The store keeps its blobs under a new name and becomes the only member of a group called {name}. Repositories keep using {name}; add more stores to the group to give it room.
blobstores.convert.member: New name of the current store
blobstores.convert.done: Blob store "{name}" is now a group
blobstores.list.loadFailed: The blob stores could not be loaded
blobstores.list.label: Blob stores table
blobstores.list.aboutText: The binary files you download through proxy repositories or publish to hosted repositories are kept in the blob store attached to those repositories. On a usual single-node installation the blob store is a folder of the local file system, inside the data directory.
blobstores.picker.title: Choose a Type
blobstores.picker.subtitle: Choose a Storage Type
blobstores.picker.text: Choose the blob store type that fits your infrastructure. Credentials and advanced settings come in the next steps.
blobstores.picker.label: Blob store types
blobstores.picker.file: Storage on the local file system. Simple and fast for single-node installations.
blobstores.picker.s3: AWS object storage. Scalable and durable, with IAM and encryption.
blobstores.picker.azure: Microsoft Azure Blob Storage. Enterprise cloud storage with a managed identity.
blobstores.picker.google: Google Cloud Storage. Object storage with application-default credentials.
blobstores.picker.group: Combines several blob stores, with fill policies such as round robin.
blobstores.picker.unavailable: This server does not support this type yet
blobstores.wizard.noCredentialsFile: File blob stores work with the local file system. Press Continue for the advanced settings.
blobstores.wizard.noCredentialsGroup: Group blob stores use the credentials of their members. Press Continue for the advanced settings.
blobstores.form.basicText: The name and required settings of the blob store
blobstores.file.sectionText: The local file system path where blobs are kept
blobstores.file.pathWarning: Changing the path does not move existing data. Blobs stored before cannot be reached at the new path.
blobstores.edit.title: Edit: {name}
blobstores.edit.subtitle: {type} Blob Store
blobstores.edit.warning: Changing the configuration makes the blob store unavailable for a moment. Configuration changes can also leave the store unusable.
blobstores.picker.remote: The disk of another server, served by the Astrum blob agent. Add it to a group to give a store more room.
